messages:
Owen R: quick flag — SMB customer 'BrightShelf' (bs-334) just dropped usage after hitting an integration error on day 10. renewal in 27 days. looks like a blocker on product->variant mapping.
Lina C: any screenshots or error text?
Owen R: user-facing modal said 'mapping failed: unknown_variant'. they tried to patch CSV and then stopped.
Theo P: that error means our variant lookup returned 404 for some SKUs. could be our upstream catalog sync lag. I'll check the sync job.
Jasmine K: propose an immediate retention move: (A) enable a temporary "variant-fallback" mode that maps unknown SKUs to a generic placeholder so imports succeed, (B) offer a 2-week onboarding accelerator (3 hours of hands-on APi help), (C) if they convert in 14 days, grant a 40% first-month credit.
Owen R: sounds good. can engineering enable a per-account toggle? want auto-revert in 48h.
Theo P: yes — will add `variant_fallback=true` for bs-334 and set TTL 48h. command: `POST /internal/customers/bs-334/flags -d '{"variant_fallback":true, "ttl_hours":48}'`
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-6123 assigned to Jasmine K — "BrightShelf retention: variant fallback + conversion incentive". Due: 2026-06-02
Lina C: Jasmine please schedule a 30-min triage call with their integrations lead and our solutions engineer. include quick remediation steps and migration timeline.
Jasmine K: scheduled for Mon 11am ET. agenda: repro, enablement session, timeline to canonical catalog sync, and rollback plan. sending invite now with a short one-pager.
Theo P: root cause: catalog-sync job lagged 3 hours due to retries after a malformed upstream payload. patched retry logic; full backfill started. I'll monitor and post the backfill id.
Owen R: for the downgrade path if they decide to avoid paying: quick bullets please so CSMs can speak to it consistently.
Jasmine K: added downgrade bullets to ticket-6123: - prorated downgrade to Lite tier for first billing period - preserve export access and one snapshot export on request - offer a 45-day reactivation credit (30% off) if they return within 60 days
Theo P: flag enabled, audit_id=aud-ff21, TTL 48h. watching for errors.
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-6123] status updated -> in-progress (Jasmine K).
Lina C: after the enablement call pls paste the 3-line feedback so product can triage UX fixes. suggested asks: what SKU formats are common, sample file, which step failed.
Jasmine K: will do. also adding a short customer-facing script for the CSMs in the ticket: neutral tone, explain fallback, timeline for full fix, and the credit.
Owen R: during the call we offered the accelerator and they accepted. good sign. I put account into "at-risk: active engagement" and set a 14-day renewal follow-up.
Theo P: backfill completed, backfill_id=bk-9082, sync delay fixed. logs show 7 previously failed SKUs now resolved.
Jasmine K: post-call feedback captured: 1) they expected clearer guidance on SKU formatting (dashes vs underscores), 2) a sample CSV would have prevented trial-error, 3) they valued the immediate hands-on help. pasted to ticket-6123.
Lina C: perfect. I'm converting feedback into a quick UX eval and a sample-file task for product. moving CSM notes to renewal playbook.
CS Ops Bot: reminder -> ticket-6123 due in 48h; status in-progress (Jasmine K).
